issues.extracted: Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1): Cash at Bank 7,384,460, Cash at County Treasurer 887,130; Restricted - Debt Service 900,318, Restricted - Capital Outlay 2,325,160, Unrestricted 5,046,111
issues.on_page: Balance Sheet - Governmental Funds, Total column (p4): same assets; fund balances Restricted Debt Service 900,318, Restricted Capital Outlay 2,325,160, Assigned School Nutrition Program 114,879, Assigned Capital Outlay 568,979, Assigned Student Activities 226,968, Assigned Employee Benefits 14,385, Unassigned 4,120,900 (total 8,271,589 = government-wide)
issues.issue: Under the user's 2026-10-27 balance-sheet rule, a cash-basis report whose governmental funds statement totals equal the government-wide figures (as here, with no capital assets, debt or interfund amounts) takes its balance-sheet lines from the governmental funds statement, with fund balance by classification. The extraction used the Statement of Net Position.

issues.extracted: no entry for School Nutrition revenue
issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund Total Cash Receipts 396,929; lines 1,071 + 117,531 + 1,727 + 276,597 + 2 = 396,928 (same on p8)
issues.issue: The printed School Nutrition receipts total doesn't add up by 1. detail_totals (396,929) doesn't equal the detail items (396,928), and report_discrepancies does not record it.

issues.extracted: transfers_in/transfers_out include 786,290 (Leasing Corporation Other Local Receipts and Special Building/Leasing Corp debt service)
issues.on_page: Madison Educational Facilities Leasing Corporation column: Other Local Receipts 786,290, Debt Service 786,290; Statement of Activities Debt Service 1,037,509
issues.issue: The extractor turned a printed receipt line and 786,290 of printed debt service into a computed intra-entity transfer, supported only by the Statement of Activities elimination. This is a material reclassification of printed amounts, and decision_needed[] has no entry for it (it only covers the 250,000 hidden transfer).

issues.extracted: Debt Service (principal) 895,073 incl. Special Building 'Debt Services' 652,902
issues.on_page: Special Building Fund: 'Debt Services' 652,902 and 'Interest on Long-Term Debt' 133,388
issues.issue: The Special Building 'Debt Services' line is generic; treating all 652,902 as principal is an assumption (the detail line also has detail_category debt principal).

issues.on_page: 3300 Community Services Operations 192,810 under the 'State Programs' heading; counted in the statement line 'Private & State Categorical Programs'
issues.issue: The user's 2026-10-28 rule says program lines follow the report's own grouping (the State Categorical heading or statement line). The line is also literally Community Service Operations. This is a judgment call; the same applies to the detail line.

issues.extracted: Extracurricular Receipts (detail_category other charges for services)
issues.issue: Community services activity receipts are not student extracurricular receipts, and the category and detail_category disagree. The statement receipt 'District Activities' 215,049 also mixes this 50,637 with the activity fund receipts 164,412.

This is the same money as the statement receipt 'Food Services', which is categorised School Lunch Sales. Under the user rule, lunch sales are School Lunch Sales, so the categories are inconsistent within the report.

issues.on_page: Depreciation Fund Other Support Services 29,523; p7 prints all Depreciation Fund disbursements (82,411) as Capital Outlay
issues.issue: The fund statement counts this line as capital outlay, but the detail function is support services.

issues.extracted: 5200 Transfers From Other Funds / 8000 Transfers / Transfers from the General Fund / Transfer
issues.issue: Not relabelled to 'Transfers In'/'Transfers Out' (with printed_label) under the user's detail other-financing label rule. The capital outlay lines 'Capital Outlay - Vehicles' and 'Capital Outlays' are also not relabelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>'.
On these signed other-financing lines the amount is negative but budget_final keeps a positive sign.

issues.on_page: Transfers In (out) 250,000 (Depreciation Fund transfer in, with the General Fund outflow inside 2650 spending)
issues.issue: This is the hidden-transfer reclassification, not a case of the printed report not adding up (the statement's own totals and roll-forward tie). Listing it in report_discrepancies will show it to the user as 'the report itself doesn't add up'.
